answer: Quadratic staking erosion forces every Sybil participant to lock collateral that scales with the square of its stake, producing super-linear capital expenditure that outpaces any extractable reward. A zero-knowledge verifiable delay binds slashing penalties to epoch finality, guaranteeing negative expected attack utility and a robust Nash equilibrium. The resulting security threshold turns the network into an oasis where even a sonnet of coordinated attackers cannot profit and the juniper of incremental capital cannot breach the barrier.
